body:
Steps 8–10 of the refactor plan (task:fc9bf315f4eddc7a, notes 6 and 12). This is part 3 of 4 of the module splits.

- **`extract`:** split into `plan`, `ffi`, `deps` and `apply`. Move `ahead` to `transactions::ahead`. Keep `merge` as the merge operation, reusing `extract::plan` and `extract::deps`. Also split `extract::rust` into submodules for extract planning, import rewriting, test-file placement and Rust `merge`.
- **`view`:** split graph construction, review scratch runs and HTTP routing (`graph`, `review`, `api`).
- **`reach`:** split data-flow and taint analysis from suite selection and report formatting (`flow`, `suites`).

All three still have inline `mod tests`, so move code out of them first.

The rules for every split task are in task:2414798176c466e4.
title: Refactor: split extract, view, reach
